title: 魔法窗口
prompt: Grainy 35mm film photo from 1975. A construction worker is installing a large glass window pane on the ground floor of a brick house. Through the clear glass, instead of seeing the interior of the room, we see a view looking down from a skyscraper at night onto a neon Tokyo metropolis. The reflection in the glass, however, correctly shows the sunny suburban garden behind the photographer. Visual anomaly, subtle horror, analog texture.
description: Nano Banana Pro 模型专为打造奇幻魔法窗口场景，以异想天开的艺术风格，完美适用于幻想主题数字艺术、动画和沉浸式视觉叙事项目。
